summary: Frontend-only retest of the return-after-login fix, the full Future Options logo change, the pilot feedback heading and a quick regression. All flows pass. The return-after-login race from iteration_7 is fixed: logged-out /lessons/lesson-05 -> /login -> lands on /lessons/lesson-05, and the saved path is cleared afterwards. The same works for /prompts, for /admin with the admin account, and for registering from /lessons/lesson-03 via 'Create an account'. A plain login goes to /dashboard. Logging out from /profile saves no return path, so the next login goes to /dashboard. The header and footer show the full logo with no horizontal overflow at 390px or 1920px. The home-screen icons use the full logo on white. The feedback heading changes correctly between the two states. Dashboard, lesson completion and admin all work, with no console errors.

issues: With the wider full logo (66x48), the brand text wraps to 'Learning AI / Africa' and the Log out button wraps onto two lines ('Log / out'). Nothing overflows, but the header looks cramped. Suggest adding whitespace-nowrap to the logout button, or using a smaller logo / hiding the tagline below the sm breakpoint.
At h-12 the 'consulting for future' tagline inside the header logo cannot be read (expected at this size, cosmetic).

action_items: Optional: tighten the mobile header (whitespace-nowrap on logout-button / smaller brand text) so Log out stays on one line at 390px
critical_code_review_comments: App.js Protected calls clearReturn() (a sessionStorage side effect) during render. It works, but would be cleaner in a useEffect. Low priority.
The saved return path persists for the whole tab session if a logged-out user leaves the login page and logs in much later. They then land on the old link, which is acceptable.
